item.title: Idealistic agents, real-world problems
item.description: I love building AI agents that are idealistic — agents aimed at problems that actually matter, not benchmarks that impress reviewers for a weekend.

item.title: RAG that cites itself
item.description: Most RAG demos retrieve a chunk and hope the model stays honest. I wanted the opposite: a pipeline where every claim carries a receipt.

item.title: Shipping real AI on a 6 GB GPU
item.description: Constraint is a feature. When you only have 6 GB of VRAM, you stop reaching for the biggest model and start engineering.
